clips.title: The story
paras: Apothecary Johaan is an alchemist and researcher of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed in Brill. Tasked by his order and Lady Sylvanas, he conducts lethal experiments on local flora and fauna to develop the Forsaken's new plague.

Working openly out of the Forsaken settlement of Brill in Tirisfal Glades, Apothecary Johaan represents the scientific ambitions of the newly formed Royal Apothecary Society. Like his colleagues across Lordaeron, Johaan operates under direct orders to craft biological and alchemical weapons capable of securing the Forsaken's fragile future against the living and the Scourge alike.
